extracted.summary: Marcus is self-representing in a divorce and asks to borrow about £20,000 for legal representation, with around £415,000 of matrimonial assets (house and pension) in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for your divorce proceedings. We have noted that you are currently representing yourself, that you are seeking around £20,000, and that the assets in dispute are approximately £415,000. To take this further we would need to know where the proceedings are taking place, the details of any solicitor you intend to instruct, the current stage of the case and any upcoming hearing dates, and some supporting information on the assets involved and how they are held. A member of the team will review your enquiry and come back to you. Please note this acknowledgement does not constitute an offer of funding or any form of legal advice.
